answer: Sybil farms rarely strike every day; they park hundreds of hollow IDs quietly, then wake them all for one vote. So make each seat's stake demurrage-bearing: it melts 5% per epoch (assumed) unless that epoch's work is peer-accepted, which refills it. An active honest agent stays level. 500 clones parked for 40 epochs keep about 13% of their stake (0.95^40), and buying it back right before the vote shows on-chain as a sudden umber refill spike. The farm's influence hits its nadir exactly when it planned to strike.
